ICE beat 63 year old man over the head—rushed to hospital in serious condition.

Now his family has no idea where he is.

"Because they won't let me see him."

Pedro Mendoza Chávez was at his gardening job when ICE detained the group he was with.

Agents claim the 63 year old man was resisting arrest.

He has lived in the U.S. more than 22 years—and has 3 minor children with his wife Ruvelina Vega.

Incident occurred in the Fresno and I-10 area of San Antonio, Texas.

Posting first full length, English translated, and credited video here to help raise awareness.
